cardTypeDescription.survivor: Survivor cards represent player characters with abilities and equipment slots.
cardTypeDescription.equipment: Equipment cards are items that survivors can equip and use.
cardTypeDescription.zombieSpawn: Zombie Spawn cards determine which zombies appear during the game.
cardTypeDescription.abomination: Abomination cards are powerful boss zombies with high health and special abilities.

plusOneAction.name: +1 Action
plusOneAction.description: The Survivor has an extra Action they may use as they please.

plusOneDamageCombat.name: +1 Damage: Combat
plusOneDamageCombat.description: The Survivor gets a +1 Damage bonus with Combat Actions.

plusOneDamageMelee.name: +1 Damage: Melee
plusOneDamageMelee.description: The Survivor gets a +1 Damage bonus with Melee Actions.

plusOneDamageRanged.name: +1 Damage: Ranged
plusOneDamageRanged.description: The Survivor gets a +1 Damage bonus with Ranged Actions.

plusOneDieCombat.name: +1 die: Combat
plusOneDieCombat.description: Each of the Survivor's weapons rolls an extra die with Combat Actions. Dual weapons each gain a die, for a total of +2 dice per Dual Combat Action.

plusOneDieMelee.name: +1 die: Melee
plusOneDieMelee.description: Each of the Survivor's weapons rolls an extra die with Melee Actions. Dual weapons each gain a die, for a total of +2 dice per Dual Melee Action.

plusOneDieRanged.name: +1 die: Ranged
plusOneDieRanged.description: Each of the Survivor's weapons rolls an extra die with Ranged Actions. Dual weapons each gain a die, for a total of +2 dice per Dual Ranged Action.

plusOneFreeCombatAction.name: +1 free Combat Action
plusOneFreeCombatAction.description: The Survivor has 1 extra free Combat Action. This Action may only be used to perform a Combat Action.

plusOneFreeMeleeAction.name: +1 free Melee Action
plusOneFreeMeleeAction.description: The Survivor has 1 extra free Melee Action. This Action may only be used to perform a Melee Action.

plusOneFreeMoveAction.name: +1 free Move Action
plusOneFreeMoveAction.description: The Survivor has 1 extra free Move Action. This Action may only be used to perform a Move Action.

plusOneFreeRangedAction.name: +1 free Ranged Action
plusOneFreeRangedAction.description: The Survivor has 1 extra free Ranged Action. This Action may only be used to perform a Ranged Action.

plusOneFreeSearchAction.name: +1 free Search Action
plusOneFreeSearchAction.description: The Survivor has 1 extra free Search Action. This Action may only be used to perform a Search Action.

plusOneMaxRange.name: +1 max Range
plusOneMaxRange.description: The maximum Range of Ranged weapons the Survivor uses is increased by 1.

plusOneZonePerMove.name: +1 Zone per Move
plusOneZonePerMove.description: When the Survivor spends 1 Action to Move, they can Move 1 or 2 Zones instead of 1. Entering a Zone containing Zombies still ends the Survivor's Move Action.

plusOneDieResultCombat.name: +1 to dice roll: Combat
plusOneDieResultCombat.description: The Survivor adds 1 to the result of each die they roll with Combat Actions. The maximum result is always 6.

plusOneDieResultMelee.name: +1 to dice roll: Melee
plusOneDieResultMelee.description: The Survivor adds 1 to the result of each die they roll with Melee Actions. The maximum result is always 6.

plusOneDieResultRanged.name: +1 to dice roll: Ranged
plusOneDieResultRanged.description: The Survivor adds 1 to the result of each die they roll with Ranged Actions. The maximum result is always 6.

damageTwoCombat.name: Combat: Damage 2
damageTwoCombat.description: Combat weapons used by the Survivor with a Damage value of 1 are considered to have a Damage value of 2.

damageTwoMelee.name: Melee: Damage 2
damageTwoMelee.description: Melee weapons used by the Survivor with a Damage value of 1 are considered to have a Damage value of 2.

damageTwoRanged.name: Ranged: Damage 2
damageTwoRanged.description: Ranged weapons used by the Survivor with a Damage value of 1 are considered to have a Damage value of 2.

twoCocktailsBetterThanOne.name: 2 cocktails are better than 1
twoCocktailsBetterThanOne.description: Roll a die each time the Survivor discards a Molotov to perform a Ranged Action. On a result of 4 or more, the Molotov Equipment card may be put in the Survivor's Backpack instead, for free. The die result may not be altered or re-rolled in any way.

ambidextrous.name: Ambidextrous
ambidextrous.description: The Survivor treats all weapons as if they had the Dual symbol.

barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.description: When resolving a Melee Action, the Survivor may substitute the Dice number of the Melee weapon(s) they use with the number of Zombies standing in their Zone. Skills affecting the dice value, like +1 die: Melee, still apply.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor spends 1 Action to Move up to 2 Zones to a Zone where Zombies are within Range of one of their equipped Ranged weapons, then gains 1 free Ranged Action. Normal Movement rules apply.

bloodlustCombat.name: Bloodlust: Combat
bloodlustCombat.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor spends 1 Action to Move up to 2 Zones to a Zone containing at least 1 Zombie, then gains 1 free Combat Action. Normal Movement rules apply.

bloodlustMelee.name: Bloodlust: Melee
bloodlustMelee.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor spends 1 Action to Move up to 2 Zones to a Zone containing at least 1 Zombie, then gains 1 free Melee Action. Normal Movement rules apply.

bloodlustRanged.name: Bloodlust: Ranged
bloodlustRanged.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor spends 1 Action to Move up to 2 Zones to a Zone containing at least 1 Zombie, then gains 1 free Ranged Action. Normal Movement rules apply.

bornLeader.name: Born leader
bornLeader.description: During the Survivor's Turn, the Survivor may give 1 free Action to another Survivor to use as they please. This Action is used immediately. Then, the Born leader Survivor resumes their Turn.

breakIn.name: Break-in
breakIn.description: The Survivor doesn't need any Equipment to open doors and doesn't make Noise while doing so. The Survivor also gains one extra free Action that can only be used to open doors.

brotherInArms.name: Brother in arms
brotherInArms.description: While standing in the same Zone as at least 1 other Survivor, each Survivor in the Zone (including the one with this Skill) benefits from the indicated Skill or game effect. Companions do not benefit from this Skill.

canSearchMoreThanOnce.name: Can Search more than once
canSearchMoreThanOnce.description: The Survivor can Search multiple times per Turn, spending 1 Action for each Search Action.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Once per Turn, for free, the Survivor moves up to 2 Zones to a Zone containing at least 1 Zombie. Normal Movement rules still apply.

combatReflexes.name: Combat reflexes
combatReflexes.description: Whenever any Zombies spawn within Range 0-1, the Survivor may immediately perform a free Combat Action against them. The Survivor may use this Skill once per Zombie card drawn.

destiny.name: Destiny
destiny.description: Once per Turn when the Survivor reveals an Equipment card they drew, they can ignore and discard that card, then draw another Equipment card from the same deck.

distributor.name: Distributor
distributor.description: When resolving the Spawn Step, draw as many Zombie Cards as there are active Spawn Zones. Look at the Zombie Cards, then assign 1 of them to each active Spawn Zone.

dreadnought.name: Dreadnought
dreadnought.description: The Survivor ignores all Wounds coming from Zombies having the indicated keyword in its name.

dualExpert.name: Dual expert
dualExpert.description: The Survivor has a free Combat Action as long as they have Dual weapons equipped. This Action may only be used with the Dual equipped weapons.

escalationCombat.name: Escalation: Combat
escalationCombat.description: The Survivor gains 1 extra die to roll for consecutive Combat Actions. The bonus is cumulative and applies until the end of the Survivor's Turn. The bonus is lost whenever the Survivor performs another kind of Action.

escalationMelee.name: Escalation: Melee
escalationMelee.description: The Survivor gains 1 extra die to roll for consecutive Melee Actions. The bonus is cumulative and applies until the end of the Survivor's Turn. The bonus is lost whenever the Survivor performs another kind of Action.

escalationRanged.name: Escalation: Ranged
escalationRanged.description: The Survivor gains 1 extra die to roll for consecutive Ranged Actions. The bonus is cumulative and applies until the end of the Survivor's Turn. The bonus is lost whenever the Survivor performs another kind of Action.

fieldMedic.name: Field medic
fieldMedic.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor spends 1 Action to Move up to 2 Zones to a Zone containing at least 1 Survivor, then may heal 1 Wound from any Survivor in the destination Zone, including themselves. Normal Movement rules apply.

freeReload.name: Free reload
freeReload.description: The Survivor reloads reloadable weapons for free.

fullAuto.name: Full auto
fullAuto.description: When resolving a Ranged Action, the Survivor may substitute the Dice number of the Ranged weapon(s) they use with the number of Zombies standing in the targeted Zone. Skills affecting the dice value, like +1 die: Ranged, still apply.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.description: The Survivor treats all Ranged weapons as if they had the Dual symbol.

hitAndRun.name: Hit & run
hitAndRun.description: For free, just after resolving a Melee or Ranged Action that eliminated at least 1 Zombie, the Survivor may make a free Move Action without spending extra Actions even if Zombies are in their Zone.

hoard.name: Hoard
hoard.description: The Survivor can carry up to 2 extra Equipment cards in their Backpack.

holdYourNose.name: Hold your nose
holdYourNose.description: The Survivor draws an Equipment card (from the Core Equipment deck only) whenever the last Zombie standing in their Zone is eliminated. This is not a Search Action.

homeDefender.name: Home defender
homeDefender.description: The Survivor is not limited to Range 0-1 when tracing Lines of Sight through building Zones.

improvisedWeaponMelee.name: Improvised weapon: Melee
improvisedWeaponMelee.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor performs a free Melee Attack using the improvised weapon's characteristics. Melee modifiers still apply.

improvisedWeaponRanged.name: Improvised weapon: Ranged
improvisedWeaponRanged.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor performs a free Ranged Attack using the improvised weapon's characteristics. Ranged modifiers still apply.

isThatAllYouveGot.name: Is That All You've Got?
isThatAllYouveGot.description: This Skill can be used any time the Survivor is about to endure Wounds. Negate 1 Wound for each Equipment card discarded from the Survivor's inventory.

jump.name: Jump
jump.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor spends 1 Action and moves 2 Zones, ignoring everything in the intervening Zone except walls and closed doors.

lifesaver.name: Lifesaver
lifesaver.description: Once per Turn, for free, the Survivor may drag chosen Survivors from a Zone at Range 1 containing Zombies to the Survivor's Zone without penalty.

lowProfile.name: Low profile
lowProfile.description: The Survivor can't get hit by Friendly Fire (Molotov rules still apply). Ignore them when shooting at the Zone they stand in.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: For each Action the Survivor takes, the player may choose to re-roll all the dice an additional time. The new result replaces the previous one.

matchingSet.name: Matching set
matchingSet.description: When the Survivor performs a Search Action and draws an Equipment card with the Dual symbol, they can immediately take a second card of the same type from the Equipment deck.

medic.name: Medic
medic.description: During each End Phase, the Survivor and all other Survivors in the same Zone may heal 1 Wound. The Survivor earns 1 AP for each Wound healed this way.

pointBlank.name: Point-blank
pointBlank.description: The Survivor can perform Ranged Actions in their own Zone regardless of minimum Range, freely choosing targets and eliminating any Zombie type. Friendly Fire is ignored.

reaperCombat.name: Reaper: Combat
reaperCombat.description: When assigning hits from a Combat Action, 1 hit can freely eliminate an additional identical Zombie in the same Zone. Only 1 additional Zombie can be eliminated per Action. The Survivor gains Adrenaline for the additional Zombie.

reaperMelee.name: Reaper: Melee
reaperMelee.description: When assigning hits from a Melee Action, 1 hit can freely eliminate an additional identical Zombie in the same Zone. Only 1 additional Zombie can be eliminated per Action. The Survivor gains Adrenaline for the additional Zombie.

reaperRanged.name: Reaper: Ranged
reaperRanged.description: When assigning hits from a Ranged Action, 1 hit can freely eliminate an additional identical Zombie in the same Zone. Only 1 additional Zombie can be eliminated per Action. The Survivor gains Adrenaline for the additional Zombie.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: During each End Phase, the Survivor's Health is fully restored to its maximum.

rollSixPlusOneDamageCombat.name: Roll 6: +1 Damage Combat
rollSixPlusOneDamageCombat.description: Add 1 to the Damage value of the weapon the Survivor uses for each 6 rolled on a Combat Action. Re-rolls must be used before determining the Damage bonus.

rollSixPlusOneDamageMelee.name: Roll 6: +1 Damage Melee
rollSixPlusOneDamageMelee.description: Add 1 to the Damage value of the weapon the Survivor uses for each 6 rolled on a Melee Action. Re-rolls must be used before determining the Damage bonus.

rollSixPlusOneDamageRanged.name: Roll 6: +1 Damage Ranged
rollSixPlusOneDamageRanged.description: Add 1 to the Damage value of the weapon the Survivor uses for each 6 rolled on a Ranged Action. Re-rolls must be used before determining the Damage bonus.

rollSixPlusOneDieCombat.name: Roll 6: +1 die Combat
rollSixPlusOneDieCombat.description: An additional die can be rolled for each 6 rolled on a Combat Action. Keep rolling additional dice as long as 6s are rolled. Re-rolls must be used before rolling additional dice.

rollSixPlusOneDieMelee.name: Roll 6: +1 die Melee
rollSixPlusOneDieMelee.description: An additional die can be rolled for each 6 rolled on a Melee Action. Keep rolling additional dice as long as 6s are rolled. Re-rolls must be used before rolling additional dice.

rollSixPlusOneDieRanged.name: Roll 6: +1 die Ranged
rollSixPlusOneDieRanged.description: An additional die can be rolled for each 6 rolled on a Ranged Action. Keep rolling additional dice as long as 6s are rolled. Re-rolls must be used before rolling additional dice.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.description: The Survivor may Search in any building or street Zone. Normal Search rules apply.

searchTwoCards.name: Search: 2 cards
searchTwoCards.description: Draw 2 cards when Searching with the Survivor.

shove.name: Shove
shove.description: Once per Turn, for free, the Survivor pushes all Zombies in their Zone to a selected Zone at Range 1. This is not a Movement.

sidestep.name: Sidestep
sidestep.description: Whenever any Zombies spawn within Range 0-1, the Survivor may immediately perform a free Move Action without extra cost even if Zombies are in their Zone. The Survivor may use this Skill once per Zombie card drawn.

slippery.name: Slippery
slippery.description: The Survivor does not spend extra Actions when performing a Move Action out of a Zone containing Zombies, and ignores Zombies when performing Move Actions.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: The Survivor may freely choose the targets of all their Ranged Actions. Friendly Fire is ignored.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.description: Once per Turn, the Survivor spends 1 Move Action to move 2 or 3 Zones instead of 1. Entering a Zone containing Zombies still ends the Move Action.

startsWithHealth.name: Starts with [X] Health
startsWithHealth.description: The Survivor starts with the indicated amount of Health. This is their base level. Survivors with this Skill cannot be used as Companions.

startsWithTwoAP.name: Starts with 2 AP
startsWithTwoAP.description: The Survivor begins the game with 2 Adrenaline Points. Survivors with this Skill cannot be used as Companions.

startsWithEquipment.name: Starts with a [Equipment]
startsWithEquipment.description: The Survivor begins the game with the indicated Equipment. Its card is automatically assigned to them during Setup. Survivors with this Skill cannot be used as Companions.

steadyHand.name: Steady hand
steadyHand.description: The Survivor can ignore other Survivors of their choosing when missing with a Ranged Action. This Skill does not apply to game effects killing everything in the targeted Zone.

superStrength.name: Super strength
superStrength.description: Consider the Damage value of Melee weapons used by the Survivor to be 3.

swordmaster.name: Swordmaster
swordmaster.description: The Survivor treats all Melee weapons as if they had the Dual symbol.

tactician.name: Tactician
tactician.description: The Survivor's Turn can be resolved anytime during the Player Phase, before or after any other Survivor's Turn. If several Survivors have this Skill, players choose their Turn order.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: Once per Turn, for free, the Survivor forces all Zombies in a Zone up to 2 Zones away (with a clear path) to gain an extra Activation and move toward the Survivor, ignoring all others.

tough.name: Tough
tough.description: The Survivor ignores the first Wound they receive during each Attack Step (Zombie Phase) and during Friendly Fire.

webbing.name: Webbing
webbing.description: All Equipment in the Survivor's inventory is considered equipped in Hand.

zombieLink.name: Zombie link
zombieLink.description: The Survivor plays an extra Turn each time an Extra Activation card (not Rushes) is drawn from the Zombie pile, before the extra-activated Zombies.

holiday.title: Holiday Survivor
holiday.description: Holiday Survivors bring festive spirit to the darkest times. Armed with seasonal gear and holiday traditions turned weapons, they celebrate survival with a smile.

kids.title: Kid Survivor
kids.description: Can use the Slippery Skill once per Turn

park.title: Park Survivor
park.description: Park Survivors were caught in the outbreak while enjoying the outdoors. Their knowledge of open spaces and physical fitness gives them an edge in navigating dangerous terrain.

police.title: Police Survivor
police.description: Police Survivors apply their combat training and crisis management experience to the zombie apocalypse. They are disciplined fighters who protect the group.

supes.title: Super Survivor
supes.description: Super Survivors possess extraordinary powers that set them apart from ordinary people. Their abilities go beyond normal human limitations, making them invaluable in the fight against the undead.

zombvivor.title: Zombivor
zombvivor.description: Zombivors are survivors who have been infected but not fully turned. They gain undead resilience — able to absorb more damage — while battling their darker instincts to remain on the side of the living.
